text: One change adds a previously missing CSP to the OpenPGP confirmation dialog. The separate nine-document follow-up adds or extends script-src to admit moz-src without replacing unrelated resource directives. A document relying on default-src chrome: has a different starting policy from one with an explicit script-src clause. Existing unsafe-inline allowances stay scoped to the affected documents. These exact declarations do not prove exhaustive coverage, runtime enforcement or a repository-wide permission recommendation. No CSP or security test ran.
title: Missed document CSPs need explicit script admission after source-address migration
